name: Gasthaus Alpenrose
beschreibung:
Perched high above the Inn Valley in Imsterberg, Gasthaus Alpenrose delights visitors with hearty regional gastronomy and comfortable guestrooms. It makes a wonderful base for alpine hikers.

The Rosengartenschlucht gorge, the Hoch-Imst Alpine Coaster, and scenic mountain trails are reachable in minutes.
kurzbeschreibung: Gasthaus Alpenrose in Imsterberg offers traditional hospitality and panoramic vistas over the Inn valley.
